description: Install the packed artifact for Claude Code with --unified-skills and assert Claude gets its own copy of the compiled skills, because it does not read the shared .agents/skills tree.
why: R32 (reality check 2026-09-22): the unified install swept Claude's nested commands and wrote the skills only to .agents/skills/, which Claude Code's skills documentation does not list as a discovery location — so Claude was left with no PAN commands while the installer printed /pan:new-project. The unit and scenario tests run from the source tree; this runs from the packed artifact.

steps.why: The shared tree for every other runtime, and Claude Code's own copy of it at the only skills path Claude reads.
The nested /pan:<name> commands are swept so nothing resolves twice, and no flat shim (R33) comes back with the copy.
